critique_history.assessment:
- The body is too bulbous and lumpy; reshape it into a cleaner laterally compressed oval with a defined tail peduncle.
- Pectoral and pelvic fins look like stiff spikes; broaden them into attached fan-shaped fins with visible rays.
- The mouth is nearly invisible and does not read as pointed or open; add separated lips and a dark opening.
- Fin membranes are overly opaque and uniformly brown; use lighter golden-brown membranes with stronger contrasting rib lines.
The fish is complete and recognizable, with an oval compressed body, clouded blue-gray skin, prominent ribbed golden fins, eye, and pointed mouth.
